## Goal

Anyone can extend Mostra through small, separately versioned contracts and copy-source packs, with honest license disclosure and no capability gates.

## Owned requirements

Close each with the check below, through the real public interface (README §3).

| ID | Requirement | Route | Concrete check |
|---|---|---|---|
| EX-01 | Extension contracts at 0.x for the points in ARCHITECTURE §17, each versioned in its own package | M | Six contract packages published at 0.x with independent versions; compatibility tests in and out of range |
| EX-02 | A plugin manifest under the `"mostra"` key with contracts, contributions, declared effects, SPDX license and bundled licenses, validated by `mostra plugin validate` | M | `mostra plugin validate` accepts valid manifests and reports each invalid field |
| EX-03 | Copy-source packs in a superset of the shadcn registry format; any shadcn item installs unchanged | I | An unchanged third-party shadcn registry item installs; Mostra packs install through shadcn too |
| EX-04 | License classes shown at install; non-OSI classes need a one-time scriptable acknowledgment recorded in the lockfile; hosts can pre-accept | I | Non-OSI fixture plugin refuses without --accept-license and installs with it; recorded in the lockfile; host pre-acceptance works |

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- the six `@mostra/contract-*` packages with `define*` blueprints;
- the plugin manifest schema and `mostra plugin validate|add|list|remove`;
- loading order, conflict and range diagnostics;
- packs as a shadcn registry superset (`mostra add` for packs, with any shadcn item installing unchanged);
- license classes and `--accept-license` recorded in the lockfile, with host pre-acceptance.

Design detail for this package:

- Six contract packages with `define*` blueprints stamping contract IDs; loader with range checks, loading order and conflict diagnostics.
- Manifest schema and `mostra plugin validate|add|list|remove`.
- Packs as shadcn registry superset; any shadcn item installs unchanged.
- License classes, `--accept-license`, lockfile record, host pre-acceptance.

## Out of scope

- First-party plugins (WP-17, WP-23, WP-25)
- The registry (v1.x)

## Acceptance evidence

contract compatibility tests (an in-range plugin loads, an out-of-range one is diagnosed); an unchanged third-party shadcn registry item installs; a non-OSI fixture plugin refuses without acknowledgment and installs with it.

Also: `pnpm check` green (from WP-01 on), diff reviewed, evidence matrix rows updated, docs and AGENTS.md current, progress report written after acceptance (README §4).

## Risks and notes

- Contracts are 0.x: additive changes only within a minor.

## Handoff

WP-17 builds the MCP App exporter on the exporter contract.
